_comment: Pre-declared gate criteria (lab, 2026-07-09). Thresholds here are FROZEN; changing one requires a dated entry in results/logs/gate_ledger.md explaining why BEFORE any rerun. Status semantics: PASS = script exit 0 AND pass-marker found; FAIL = exit 1 or fail-marker; NOT_RUN = exit 2 or missing dependency; ERROR = crash.

gates.name: Quantum foam ergodicity (partial G0)
gates.criterion: 3-seed foam density stable; NOTE: does NOT test c_s/ghosts - see G0b

gates.name: Full-branch stability (ghosts, c_s, both signs of X)
gates.criterion: REFINED (ledger 2026-07-09): P_X>0 and P_X+2X P_XX>0 branch-wide for the declared DBI completion; benign-class superluminality admitted (naive c_s<=1 both branches proven unsatisfiable)

gates.name: Standard Model spectrum from Cl(6)
gates.criterion: exact chiral multiplet counts + anomaly sum = 0

gates.name: CMB TT/TE/EE + P(k) vs real Planck 2018 binned spectra
gates.criterion: UPGRADED (ledger 2026-08-14, pre-registered): CAMB w/ published Planck params vs real binned TT/TE/EE, diagonal chi2_red < 1.5 each; tower k_fs > 1e3 h/Mpc derived; sigma_8 within 3 sigma of 0.8111+/-0.0060

gates.name: SPARC rotation curves (held-out)
gates.criterion: a0 fitted on train half only; held-out test chi2_red < 5.0

gates.name: Solar-system screening (NPL 3D solver, cross-check)
gates.criterion: 3D Vainshtein: all planets below bound; known to disagree with G4 - discrepancy tracked

gates.name: BBN phase transition (PRyMordial)
gates.criterion: computed |dYp/Yp| < 0.4% with PRyMordial; NOT RUN if engine absent
